title: Enterprise Support: Completed provider export hours for paid rate-error review
content:
Enterprise Support — Completed provider export hours for paid rate-error review.

## Decision basis

For paid rate-error review: Sum completed primary provider-spending export vCPU-hours quantity for the exact original support charge and service period; rejected exports and other source periods are excluded.

## Hypothetical case

For paid rate-error review: Suppose two hypothetical qualifying records for the specified source and service period contain quantities of 12 and 8 in the stated unit. Their contribution totals 20. A record for another source or period does not enter that total.
